MultiNewton.step(x, step, r, loglevel).scientific_purpose: Compute undamped Newton correction step delta_x = -J^{-1} F(x)

MultiNewton.boundStep(x0, step0, r, logl.scientific_purpose: Compute multiplier fbound in [0, 1] ensuring x0 + fbound*step0 stays within [lower, upper] bounds

MultiNewton.dampStep(x0, step0, x1, step.scientific_purpose: Find damping factor alpha_k such that norm(delta x_{k+1}) < norm(delta x_k) or converges

callees: dampStep(x, stp, x1, stp1, s1, r, loglevel-1, write_header)
MultiNewton.solve(x0, x1, r, loglevel).scientific_purpose: Top-level bounded damped Newton iteration solving F(x) = 0 for 1D multi-domain networks

MultiJac.reset().scientific_purpose: Zero out Jacobian elements and reset age counter

MultiJac.initialize(nVars).scientific_purpose: Dimension Jacobian for nVars variables and allocate steady-state diagonal cache

MultiJac.setBandwidth(bw).scientific_purpose: Configure banded storage bandwidth kl=bw, ku=bw

MultiJac.setValue(row, col, value).scientific_purpose: Set individual element J(row, col) and cache steady diagonal

MultiJac.updateTransient(rdt, mask).scientific_purpose: Update diagonal terms M = J - mask * rdt and factorize system matrix

MultiJac.solve(b, x).scientific_purpose: Solve linear system M * x = b using banded LU factorization
